email_subject: Application - Global Paid Social Media Specialist
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Global Paid Social Media Specialist role at Lotus Bakeries. Your focus on building paid social capabilities across iconic brands like Biscoff and nākd. immediately caught my attention.

In my current digital marketing roles, I manage SEO and content for client websites, using data from Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs to guide decisions. While my hands-on paid social experience is still developing, I have a strong foundation in digital advertising through Google Ads and a technical background that helps me quickly grasp platform mechanics. I'm eager to apply my analytical mindset and structured approach to campaign setup, optimization and reporting.

I'm fluent in English, based in Belgium, and excited about the opportunity to learn from your team and agency partners while contributing to best-in-class social advertising.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Global Paid Social Media Specialist position at Lotus Bakeries. The opportunity to contribute to the paid social capabilities of brands like Biscoff, nākd., TREK, BEAR and Kiddylicious across global markets is exactly the kind of challenge I am seeking.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I manage SEO and content for client websites, using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs to track performance and derive actionable insights. I have hands-on experience with Google Ads and a solid understanding of digital advertising metrics. While my direct experience with Meta and TikTok Ads Manager is limited, my technical background in front-end development and my daily use of AI tools and automation enable me to quickly learn and master new platforms. I am confident in my ability to support campaign setup, monitoring and optimization, and to collaborate effectively with agency partners.

I bring a structured and detail-oriented approach, demonstrated by managing multiple client projects simultaneously, from website builds to content calendars. My analytical mindset helps me translate data into clear recommendations, and I thrive in fast-paced environments where testing and learning are continuous. I am fluent in English and based in Belgium, ready to contribute to a dynamic international team.

I am eager to bring my skills to Lotus Bakeries and help elevate your paid social advertising. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Digital marketing experience across SEO, content and web, with a strong analytical mindset using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs.
• Hands-on Google Ads experience and understanding of digital advertising metrics, eager to apply to paid social platforms.
• Technical background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and daily AI tool use, enabling quick mastery of new ad platforms.
• Structured and detail-oriented, managing multiple client projects and campaigns simultaneously.
• Fluent in English, based in Belgium, with a proactive self-starter approach and strong collaboration skills.
